s.en: display disk space usage on a network entity via SNMP

o.en: Forces the command to use dskTable in mib UCD-SNMP-MIB instead of the default to determine the storage information. Generally, the default use of hrStorageTable in mib HOST-RESOURCES-MIB is preferred because it typically contains more information.
Print sizes in human readable format (i.e. MiB, GiB, TiB)
Print sizes in human readable SI format (i.e. MB, GB, TB)
